model.description: GPT-2-derived fixed optimizer benchmark, not original GPT-2

training.gradient_reduction: sum, as in upstream; do not silently average

data.revision_policy: pin dataset commit and every shard hash before training
data.validation_policy: public benchmark validation for reproduction; reserve a distinct evaluation slice before candidate selection

evaluation.quality_comparison: matched end-to-end GPU-hour budget, plus fixed-token results
evaluation.speed_comparison: GPU-hours and wall time to the same preregistered PPL target
evaluation.speed_threshold_status: user has not selected numerical thresholds; report frontier without inventing approval
also_report: cold and reused compilation cache status
evaluation.do_not_use: PPL divided by seconds as a universal utility score
evaluation.confirmation: lock baseline/candidate hyperparameters on development data before paired new-seed confirmation
claim_limits: published settings are validated anchors, not proven global optima
one successful reproduction is not optimizer superiority
